notes:
Need to search first.I wasn't able to write any notes on Ezekiel 8, because I couldn't get into any of the approved sources.

**What happened**

1. **My first attempt was blocked.** I tried to open these pages directly:
   - Enduring Word on Ezekiel 8
   - Ellicott, Gill and the Pulpit Commentary on Bible Hub
   - Precept Austin
   - the NET Bible notes

   All six were refused because the tool only opens a page after a search has turned it up first.
2. **My second attempt didn't go through.** I then ran a set of searches (Tammuz, "the branch to their nose", the seventy elders and Jaazaniah, the fiery figure in v. 2, the "chambers of imagery", and the glory leaving the temple). The tool then said I had no more tool calls left for this turn, so I got no results back.

**Why there are no notes at all**

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and never fill gaps from my own knowledge. I didn't read any pages, so any verse notes, comparison between traditions or "other views" I wrote now would come from memory, not from sources, and wouldn't have real links. I've left them out rather than break your rules.

**What I'd do next time**

Once the tools are available again, I'd start by searching each site and then open the pages the searches turn up:
- verse-by-verse commentaries: Enduring Word, Bible Hub (Ellicott, Gill, Pulpit, Benson, Matthew Henry), StudyLight and Precept Austin
- NET Bible notes on vv. 3, 14 and 17
- the Reformed, Baptist, Wesleyan and other tradition sites, for sermons on Ezekiel 8
- the Catholic and Orthodox sites (New Advent, catholic.com, OCA), for the Church Fathers on Ezekiel

If you send the request again, I'll start there and write the notes verse by verse with a link for every point.
